notes: Tom Steyer is the founder and former head of Farallon Capital Management, climate activist, candidate for President of the United States in 2020, and most recently, co-founder of Galvanize Climate Solutions, a mission driven investment platform addressing urgent climate solutions. Our conversation covers Tom's early career and founding of Farallon in 1986. We discuss his original strategy, history, and succession to new leaders at the firm. We then turn to Tom's retirement from Farallon, work on the environment, and Presidential run. From there, we dive into Tom's return to the investment business at Galvanize, covering his investment thesis, strategies to deploy, and creation of another investment organization today. All the way through, Tom shares a lifetime's worth of investing and business wisdom. For full show notes, visit the episode webpage here .  Tom Steyer – Investing to Save Humanity (Climate Solutions EP.1, Capital Allocators EP. 300) Mar 6, 2023

 Tom Steyer is the founder and
former head of Farallon Capital Management, climate activist,
candidate for President of the United States in 2020, and most
recently, co-founder of Galvanize Climate Solutions, a mission
driven investment platform addressing urgent climate
solutions. 

 

Our conversation covers Tom’s early career and founding of Farallon
in 1986. We discuss his original strategy, history, and succession
to new leaders at the firm. We then turn to Tom’s retirement from
Farallon, work on the environment, and Presidential run. From
there, we dive into Tom’s return to the investment business at
Galvanize, covering his investment thesis, strategies to deploy,
and creation of another investment organization today. All the way
through, Tom shares a lifetime’s worth of investing and business
wisdom. 

  

 For full show notes, visit the

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
